payload.claim: The problem statement requires the outside-line identifier rescue to be checked against every name in a citation's clause, not only the name(s) that opened a found construct ("Count every name, not only construct names"). No test exercises a clause with two names where only one opens a construct and the citation is rescued by the *other*, construct-less name appearing on an outside line. In every multi-name fixture (e.g. `Both _diff and _print_summary matter`), both names already open constructs, so restricting the rescue loop to just the first name changes nothing observable. Replacing `for name in cite.names` with `for name in cite.names[:1]` keeps every current test green while silently dropping the documented multi-name rescue behavior.
